answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A sable of per-task receipts records who did what, and the zephyr of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
